# config_server

A single-process REST service that stores JSON configuration objects with
immutable versions, exact-match scoping, rollback, and ordered
imports/inheritance across configs. Standard library only.

## Run

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt   # no third-party deps
./config_server --address 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

`pip install -e .` also installs a `config_server` console script.

## Test

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

## Endpoints (all under `/v1`, JSON in / canonical JSON out)

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/healthz` | liveness, `{"ok":true}` |
| POST | `/v1/configs/{name}` | create a new immutable version |

| POST | `/v1/configs/{name}/{version}:activate` | make a version active |
